To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the integration of traffic data mining and micro simulation modelling can reduce traffic congestion at a signalized intersection.
the integration of computer vision data mining techniques, traffic experts, and traffic simulation modeling can be used to reduce traffic congestion.

(1) a computer vision tool can accurately extract traffic flow data from video footage; (2) the extracted data can be analyzed by a data mining process to yield greater than 90 percent accuracy; and (3) the data mining results, along with input from a local traffic expert, can be used to simulate custom variable timing profiles for traffic signals that reduce traffic congestion at a given intersection by 40 percent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the systematic integration of video-based traffic data collection, data mining, and microsimulation modelling to reduce traffic congestion.
the integration of data mining techniques with a microsimulation model to optimize traffic signal control at congested intersections.
the systematic integration of intelligent transportation technologies and data mining to reduce traffic congestion in developing countries.
